description: This Java class defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application. It intercepts various exceptions such as NotFoundException, validation errors, IllegalArgumentException, and generic exceptions, converting them into structured HTTP responses with appropriate status codes and message bodies.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring ControllerAdvice class that globally handles exceptions such as NotFoundException, validation errors, IllegalArgumentException, and generic exceptions, returning structured HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException by returning a 404 Not Found response with a custom message.

methods.name: handleMethodArgumentNotValid
methods.description: Overrides the default method to handle validation errors, returning a 400 Bad Request with details about validation failures.

methods.name: handleIllegalArgument
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException by returning a 400 Bad Request with the exception message.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles any other unhandled exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error.

methods.name: defaultBody
methods.description: Constructs a standard response body map with timestamp, status, error, and message.
